title: Aerial of Burned Homes in the Korean Village on the island of Jeju
partOf: NARA › RG 111 › Photographs of American Military Activities
summary: Original Caption: An aerial view of burned homes in a small Korea village on the Island of Cheju [Jeju]. The recent wave of communist terror on the island is being brought under control by the Korean Constabulary. Chuju-Do [Jeju-Do], Korea. Photographer: Mootz.
